data.name: SenderName
data.value: IT Department

data.name: Footer
data.value: This message was sent automatically by the IT department. We never ask for your password – do not reply to messages asking for it and do not click their links.

data.name: password-expiring.Name
data.value: Password expires in N days

data.name: password-expiring.Subject
data.value: The password of your account {sAMAccountName} expires on {$passwordExpires:d MMMM yyyy}

data.name: password-expiring.Body
data.value:
Hello {givenName},
the password of your account {sAMAccountName} expires on {$passwordExpires:d MMMM yyyy} (days left: {$passwordExpiresInDays}).
Please change it before then: on your company computer press Ctrl+Alt+Del and choose "Change a password". After the change, sign in again on all your devices (phone, laptop, VPN).
If you need help, contact the IT helpdesk.

data.name: password-expired.Name
data.value: Password expired

data.name: password-expired.Subject
data.value: The password of your account {sAMAccountName} has expired

data.name: password-expired.Body
data.value:
Hello {givenName},
the password of your account {sAMAccountName} expired on {$passwordExpires:d MMMM yyyy}. Until you change it you cannot sign in to e-mail, VPN or company applications.
Change the password at your next sign-in on a company computer or contact the IT helpdesk.

data.name: account-expiring.Name
data.value: Account expires in N days

data.name: account-expiring.Subject
data.value: The account {sAMAccountName} expires on {$accountExpires:d MMMM yyyy}

data.name: account-expiring.Body
data.value:
Hello,
the account {displayName} ({sAMAccountName}) is valid until {$accountExpires:d MMMM yyyy} inclusive (days left: {$accountExpiresInDays}).
If the work continues after that date, the manager should ask the IT department to extend the account in time.

data.name: account-expired.Name
data.value: Account expired

data.name: account-expired.Subject
data.value: The account {sAMAccountName} has expired

data.name: account-expired.Body
data.value:
Hello,
the account {displayName} ({sAMAccountName}) has expired – its last valid day was {$accountExpires:d MMMM yyyy}.
If the account is still needed, the manager should ask the IT department to extend it.

data.name: account-locked.Name
data.value: Account locked out

data.name: account-locked.Subject
data.value: Your account {sAMAccountName} is locked out

data.name: account-locked.Body
data.value:
Hello {givenName},
your account {sAMAccountName} was locked out on {$lockedSince:d MMMM yyyy, HH:mm} after several failed sign-in attempts.
If it was not you who tried to sign in, contact the IT helpdesk immediately. To unlock the account, call the helpdesk or wait for the automatic unlock.

data.name: account-unlocked.Name
data.value: Account unlocked

data.name: account-unlocked.Subject
data.value: Your account {sAMAccountName} has been unlocked

data.name: account-unlocked.Body
data.value:
Hello {givenName},
your account {sAMAccountName} has been unlocked – you can sign in again.
If you do not remember your password, contact the IT helpdesk before trying several times – the account would be locked out again.

data.name: must-change-password.Name
data.value: Must change password at next logon

data.name: must-change-password.Subject
data.value: You must change the password of your account {sAMAccountName}

data.name: must-change-password.Body
data.value:
Hello {givenName},
at your next sign-in to the account {sAMAccountName} you will be asked to set a new password. Sign in on a company computer and follow the instructions on the screen.
Working remotely? Connect to the VPN first or contact the IT helpdesk.

data.name: inactive-disable.Name
data.value: Account will be disabled (inactivity)

data.name: inactive-disable.Subject
data.value: The account {sAMAccountName} will be disabled on {$input:termin}

data.name: inactive-disable.Body
data.value:
Hello,
the account {displayName} ({sAMAccountName}) has not been used since {$lastLogon:d MMMM yyyy}. According to the security policy it will be disabled on {$input:termin}.
If the account is still needed, sign in before that date or ask your manager to contact the IT department.
